title: Samson's Vengeance

questions.question: What did Samson try to visit his wife with?
questions.explanation: Judges 15:1 (ESV): "After some days... Samson visited his wife with a young goat..."

questions.question: Who prevented him from entering?
questions.explanation: Judges 15:1 (ESV): "...But her father would not allow him to go in."

questions.question: What did Samson use to burn the Philistine crops?
options: 300 foxes with torches tied to their tails
questions.correctAnswer: 300 foxes with torches tied to their tails
questions.explanation: Judges 15:4-5 (ESV): "So Samson went and caught 300 foxes... and he set fire to the torches and let the foxes go into the standing grain..."

questions.question: How many men of Judah came to bind Samson?
questions.explanation: Judges 15:11 (ESV): "Then 3,000 men of Judah went down to the cleft of the rock of Etam..."

questions.question: What did Samson use to kill 1,000 Philistines?
options: A fresh jawbone of a donkey
questions.correctAnswer: A fresh jawbone of a donkey
questions.explanation: Judges 15:15 (ESV): "And he found a fresh jawbone of a donkey... and struck down 1,000 men with it."

questions.question: What did the Philistines do in retaliation for the crops?
options: Burned Samson's wife and her father with fire
questions.correctAnswer: Burned Samson's wife and her father with fire
questions.explanation: Judges 15:6 (ESV): "...And the Philistines came up and burned her and her father with fire."

questions.question: Where did Samson stay after attacking the Philistines “hip and thigh”?
options: In the cleft of the rock of Etam
questions.correctAnswer: In the cleft of the rock of Etam
questions.explanation: Judges 15:8 (ESV): "...and he went down and stayed in the cleft of the rock of Etam."

questions.question: What did the men of Judah ask Samson?
options: Do you not know that the Philistines are rulers over us? What then is this that you have done to us?
questions.correctAnswer: Do you not know that the Philistines are rulers over us? What then is this that you have done to us?
questions.explanation: Judges 15:11 (ESV): "...Do you not know that the Philistines are rulers over us? What then is this that you have done to us?"

questions.question: What happened to the ropes when the Spirit of the Lord rushed on Samson?
options: They became like flax that has burned with fire and melted off
questions.correctAnswer: They became like flax that has burned with fire and melted off
questions.explanation: Judges 15:14 (ESV): "...and the ropes that were on his arms became like flax that has caught fire, and his bonds melted off his hands."

questions.question: What did Samson name the place where he killed the 1,000 men?
questions.explanation: Judges 15:17 (ESV): "...and he called the name of that place Ramath-lehi." (Hill of the Jawbone).

questions.question: How did God provide water for Samson?
options: He split open the hollow place at Lehi
He led him to a well
questions.correctAnswer: He split open the hollow place at Lehi
questions.explanation: Judges 15:19 (ESV): "And God split open the hollow place that is at Lehi, and water came out from it..."

questions.question: What does En-hakkore mean?
options: The spring of him who called
questions.correctAnswer: The spring of him who called
questions.explanation: Judges 15:19 (ESV): "...Therefore the name of it was called En-hakkore..." (Footnote: The spring of him who called).

questions.question: Why did the father offer the younger sister?
options: She is more beautiful than the older one
questions.correctAnswer: She is more beautiful than the older one
questions.explanation: Judges 15:2 (ESV): "...Is not her younger sister more beautiful than she? Please take her instead."

questions.question: What excuse did the father give for giving Samson's wife away?
options: I really thought that you utterly hated her
questions.correctAnswer: I really thought that you utterly hated her
questions.explanation: Judges 15:2 (ESV): "And her father said, 'I really thought that you utterly hated her, so I gave her to your companion.'"

questions.question: How long did Samson judge Israel in the days of the Philistines?
questions.explanation: Judges 15:20 (ESV): "And he judged Israel in the days of the Philistines twenty years."

key_verse_text: And God split open the hollow place that is at Lehi, and water came out from it. And when he drank, his spirit returned, and he revived. (ESV)
